name: mctools-app
description: Minecraft Creator Tools for building Bedrock Edition add-ons.
author: Mojang AB

scripts.rebuild-deps: npm rebuild --no-ignore-scripts electron esbuild @vscode/vsce-sign @playwright/browser-chromium keytar electron-winstaller
scripts.preparedevenv: npm run rebuild-deps && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npx gulp preparedevenv
scripts.preparetest: npx --package=@playwright/test -- playwright install && cd ../samplecontent/addon && npm ci && npx gulp package && cd ../world && npm ci && npx gulp package && cd ../../app
scripts.preparemc: cd ../mc && npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && npm run rebuild-deps && npm run build && npm run package && cd ../app
scripts.webbuild: npm run env:options -- CI=true vite build
scripts.jsntest: npm run jsnbuild && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test-web-core
scripts.process: npm run-script enablejsn && npx ./toolbuild/jsn/ validate --force --warn-only -q --ot noreports -i ./public/res/latest/van/release/ -o ./public/data && npx ./toolbuild/jsn/ validate --force --warn-only -q --ot noreports -i ./public/res/latest/van/preview/ -o ./public/data && npx ./toolbuild/jsn/ validate --force --warn-only -q --ot noreports -i ./public/res/samples/microsoft/samples/ -o ./public/data && npx gulp copyjsnodedata
scripts.updatetests: rm -r test/scenarios && cp -r test/results test/scenarios && npx --package=@playwright/test -- playwright test BlockViewer.spec.ts --project=chromium --timeout=120000 --update-snapshots
scripts.processdocs: npm run-script enablejsn && npm run-script updateformsource && npm run-script processcontent && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npx ./toolbuild/jsn docsgeneratemarkdown --base-path ./public/ -i ./public/data/forms/ -o ./debugoutput/msdocs/
scripts.processdocs-safe: npm run-script enablejsn && npm run-script updateformsource && npm run-script processcontent && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npx ./toolbuild/jsn docsgeneratemarkdown --base-path ./public/ -i ./public/data/forms/ -o ./debugoutput/msdocs/ -ref ./../../minecraft-creator-pr/creator/Reference/Content
scripts.updatefromdocs: npm run-script updateformsource && npm run-script processcontent && npm run-script updatejsontypes
scripts.lint-deps: node scripts/check-pinned-dependencies.js package.json jsnode/package.json libnode/package.json vscode/package.json ../mc/package.json ../samplecontent/addon/package.json ../samplecontent/world/package.json
scripts.all: npm install && npm run-script preparemc && npm run-script allbuild && npm run-script lint && npm run-script preparetest && npm run-script test && npm run-script test-web
scripts.allbuild: npm run-script preparedevenvandjsnbuild && npm run-script webvscappbuild
scripts.preparedevenvandjsnbuild: npm run-script preparedevenv && npm run-script jsnbuild && npm run-script process
scripts.corebuild: npm run-script jsnbuild && npm run-script webbuild
scripts.webvscappbuild: npm run-script webbuild && npm run-script vscbuild && npm run-script appbuildandsetup
scripts.updateversionsandbuild: npx gulp updateversions && npm run-script webbuild && npm run-script jsnbuild && npm run-script process && npm run-script vscbuild && npm run-script appbuildandsetup && npx gulp customizesite
scripts.updateversionsandreleasebuild: npx gulp updateversions && npm run-script webbuild && npm run-script jsnbuild && npm run-script process && npx gulp customizesite
scripts.appbuild: npm run-script webbuild && npm run-script jsncorebuild && npm run-script appcorebuild
scripts.appdebugbuild: npm run-script webbuild && npm run-script jsncorebuild && cross-env FORGE_DEBUG=1 electron-forge package
scripts.test: npm run test-default && npm run test-unit
scripts.test-mcp: ts-mocha --type-check -p tsconfig.test.json src/test/McpToolsTest.ts src/test/McpSkillLibraryTest.ts src/test/McpWorkingFolderTest.ts src/test/SkillsCommandTest.ts src/test/CliReferenceTest.ts src/test/McpRequestGuardTest.ts src/test/HttpServerMcpRoutingTest.ts
scripts.test-mcp-unit: ts-mocha --type-check -p tsconfig.test.json src/test/McpToolsTest.ts src/test/McpSkillLibraryTest.ts src/test/McpWorkingFolderTest.ts src/test/SkillsCommandTest.ts src/test/CliReferenceTest.ts src/test/McpRequestGuardTest.ts src/test/HttpServerMcpRoutingTest.ts
scripts.test-cli: ts-mocha --type-check -p tsconfig.test.json src/test/CommandLineTest.ts src/test/ProjectCommandLineTest.ts src/test/ServerCommandLineTest.ts src/test/ContentCommandLineTest.ts src/test/CliTranscriptTest.ts src/test/CliTestIsolationTest.ts
scripts.test-validation-coverage: npm run test-validation-catalog && npm run test-validation-harness && npm run test-validation-size-audit
scripts.test-electron-full: npm run webbuild && npm run jsncorebuild && playwright test --config playwright-electron.config.ts
scripts.test-electron-debugger-gate: cross-env MCT_BDS_DEBUGGER_GATE=true playwright test --config playwright-electron.config.ts DebuggerRealBdsGate
scripts.test-electron-debugger-gate-full: npm run webbuild && npm run jsncorebuild && cross-env MCT_BDS_DEBUGGER_GATE=true playwright test --config playwright-electron.config.ts DebuggerRealBdsGate
scripts.test-vsc-full: npm run vscdevbuild && npm run test-vsc
scripts.test-production-full: npm run webbuild && playwright test --config playwright-production.config.js
scripts.docker-build: cd toolbuild/jsn && npm pack && cd ../.. && docker build -f docker-dev/Dockerfile -t mct:latest .
scripts.docker-stop: docker stop mct-server && docker rm mct-server

overridesNotes._comment: package.json is strict JSON and cannot hold inline comments; this npm-ignored key documents non-obvious overrides so a future dependency refresh does not silently drop or downgrade them.
overridesNotes.brace-expansion: The @1/@2/@5 pins (1.1.16 / 2.1.3 / 5.0.8) are each the LATEST published release in their major. They clear the earlier GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp, and 2.1.3 (published 2026-07-28) / 5.0.8 (published 2026-07-23) CLOSE GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg / CVE-2026-14257 (High, CVSS 7.5 DoS: a chained-brace glob keeps result COUNT under the 100k cap while growing each result's LENGTH, exhausting memory into an uncatchable OOM) for every 2.x and 5.x copy in this tree; that advisory's 1.x fix (1.1.17) was never published and is superseded below. KNOWN-UNRESOLVED and tracked: the successor GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (High, published 2026-08-03: DoS via unbounded INTERMEDIATE arrays, bypassing the CVE-2026-14257 mitigation) affects <1.1.18, 2.x <2.1.4, and 4.0.0 through 5.0.8 — i.e. ALL THREE pinned versions — and names 1.1.18 / 2.1.4 / 5.0.9 as the first fixes, NONE of which are published to npm as of 2026-08-04, so no released-version pin can close it. Keep these pins at the highest available release; do not assume a refresh has fixed it. When 1.1.18 / 2.1.4 / 5.0.9 (or later) publish, bump every pin here plus mc/, samplecontent/addon, samplecontent/world, toexternal/app, regenerate all lockfiles, and add a constrained-heap child-process regression test using the chained-brace pattern to confirm remediation. Separately, the ROOT package-lock.json carries a brace-expansion 5.0.7 copy frozen inBundle inside npm (@semantic-release/npm -> npm@^11.6.2) that overrides cannot reach — see root package.json securityNotes. Runtime exposure is low in practice: brace-expansion is reached via glob/minimatch over developer-supplied patterns, not attacker-controlled input at product runtime.
overridesNotes.nanoid: Scoped to mocha only (do not make this a global override): mocha pins nanoid to the exact vulnerable release 3.3.3 (CVE-2024-55565 / GHSA-mwcw-c2x4-8c55, fixed in 3.3.8), so its copy must be forced; 3.3.16 is the latest 3.x release. nanoid 4+ is ESM-only and mocha is CJS, so 3.x is the ceiling for this pin. Every other consumer (currently postcss, which declares ^3.3.16) resolves its own compatible copy naturally — an earlier GLOBAL nanoid=3.3.8 override forced postcss below its declared floor, which is why this must stay scoped.
overridesNotes.dompurify: Pinned to 3.4.12 to clear the DOMPurify advisories (all versions through 3.4.11 are affected, including GHSA-c2j3-45gr-mqc4 which is patched in 3.4.12; DOMPurify 2 is not a safe fallback). tui-grid@4.21.22 is the LATEST release, declares dompurify ^2.3.9, and there is no tui-grid version that supports DOMPurify 3, so this is an intentional major-range mismatch. tui-grid is the ONLY dompurify consumer in the tree, and its shipped bundle (dist/tui-grid.js) statically INLINES DOMPurify 2.3.9 with no external require('dompurify') — so this override does not actually change tui-grid's runtime sanitization (the forced-major compatibility risk is moot); it only keeps node_modules/dompurify on a patched release for npm audit. The bundled 2.3.9 IS reachable at runtime: tui-grid's built-in DefaultRenderer renders every ordinary cell via innerHTML = sanitize(value), and the sole consumer (StatusList.tsx, via GridEditor.tsx) shows values (project status messages/context) that can originate from persisted preferences JSON, so a crafted value could reach the mXSS-affected bundled sanitizer (GHSA-gx9m-whjm-85jf). This is mitigated in GridEditor.tsx: every column defaults to TextCellRenderer (TextCellRenderer.ts), which writes cell values via textContent instead of innerHTML, so values are never parsed as HTML and the bundled sanitizer path is never reached. Do not remove or downgrade, and do not reintroduce innerHTML-based cell renderers for untrusted values. Fully removing the residual inlined 2.3.9 requires replacing tui-grid (unmaintained) with an MUI table.
